description: This source file defines a class ProfileReader that implements IProfileReader to read user profile information from the database, handle user follow status, and map data models to API response models.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading user profiles, including follow status, based on username input.

methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user profile by username, includes follow status if applicable, and maps database entities to API response models.
